column3: Close to the Hebrew; “it was evil to Jonah, a great evil, and it burned to him” is rendered “it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he became angry.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness,” and “relenting concerning the evil” “One who relents from doing harm.”
Close to the Hebrew; “is it rightly burning to you?” is rendered “Is it right for you to be angry?”
Close to the Hebrew; “Jonah rejoiced a great joy” is rendered “Jonah was very grateful.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it attacked the plant” is rendered “it so damaged the plant.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a hot east wind” is rendered “a vehement east wind,” and “he asked his life to die” “he wished death for himself.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a son of a night” is rendered “which came up in a night.”
Close to the Hebrew; “twelve ten-thousands” is rendered “one hundred and twenty thousand.”
